name: Garnier Men Oil Clear Deep Cleansing Icy Face Wash 50gm | India
description:
Garnier Men Oil Clear Deep Cleansing Icy Face Wash 50gm | India
Apply on wet face, gently massage in with fingertips while avoiding the eye contour. Rinse off. Suitable for daily use.
Day-long oil-free feel: Containing cooling Cryo-menthol and oil-absorbing mineral clay, it makes skin clean & fresh. It has a day-long oil-free feel.
Removes excessive oil without drying: Its special oil-trapping mud texture eliminates excessive oil without drying for an intensive anti-grease action.
